# `to_json`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a JSON string with a given struct value

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_json(expr[, options])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_json, example 1
> SELECT to_json(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2));
{"a":1,"b":2}
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 2
> SELECT to_json(named_struct('time', to_timestamp('2015-08-26', 'yyyy-MM-dd')), map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'));
{"time":"26/08/2015"}
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 3
> SELECT to_json(array(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2)));
[{"a":1,"b":2}]
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 4
> SELECT to_json(map('a', named_struct('b', 1)));
{"a":{"b":1}}
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 5
> SELECT to_json(map(named_struct('a', 1),named_struct('b', 2)));
{"[1]":{"b":2}}
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 6
> SELECT to_json(map('a', 1));
{"a":1}
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 7
> SELECT to_json(array(map('a', 1)));
[{"a":1}]
```

```sql
-- to_json, example 8
> SELECT to_json(named_struct('b', 1, 'a', 2), map('sortKeys', 'true'));
{"a":2,"b":1}
```
